exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  from        11  am
   2  are         12  in
   3  an          13  has
   4  He          14  can
   5  How         15  friend
   6  What's      16  can
   7  isn't       17  straight
   8  has         18  hear
   9  are         19  Where
  10  are         20  like

⚠ 10, 13, 14-bandlar GAP BOSHIDA turadi,
shuning uchun kitobda BOSH HARF bilan
yoziladi: Are ... ? / Has ... ? / Can ... ?


GURUHLARGA BO'LIB TUShUNTIRISh:

──── 'TO BE' FE'LI ────

 2  'They ARE friends.'
    'they' — ko'plik → ARE

 7  'Is she from Italy? — No, she ISN'T.'
    Qisqa javobda savoldagi fe'l
    takrorlanadi (inkor shaklda).

 9  'What colour ARE your eyes?'
    'eyes' — KO'PLIK → ARE

10  'ARE you from Australia?'
    Savolda 'be' EGADAN OLDIN.

11  'I AM twelve years old.'
    'I' bilan DOIM 'am'.


──── ARTIKL ────

 3  'He is AN astronaut.'
    ⚠ 'astronaut' UNLI tovush bilan
    boshlanadi → 'AN'
    ('a astronaut' XATO)


──── OLMOSH ────

 4  'This is Steve Richway. HE is a teacher.'
    Steve — erkak → HE


──── SAVOL SO'ZLARI ────

 5  'HOW old are you?' = necha yoshdasiz?
 6  'WHAT'S your name?' = isming nima?
19  'WHERE are you from?' = qayerdansiz?


──── 'HAVE GOT' ────

 8  'What sort of hair HAS she got?'
    'she' → HAS

13  'HAS Pierre got green eyes?'
    'Pierre' — birlik → HAS


──── 'CAN' ────

14  'CAN you sing? — Yes, quite well.'
16  'He CAN run very fast.'


──── PREDLOG ────

 1  'Daniel is FROM Lisbon, Portugal.'
    'be FROM' = ... dan bo'lmoq

12  'Big Ben is IN London.'
    Shahar bilan 'IN'.


──── LUG'AT ────

15  'A FRIEND in need is a friend indeed.'
    ⚠ Bu — INGLIZ MAQOLI!
    So'zma-so'z: 'Muhtojlikdagi do'st —
    haqiqiy do'st.'
    O'zbekcha: 'Do'st boshga kulfat
    tushganda bilinadi.'

17  'He hasn't got curly hair; he's got
     STRAIGHT hair.'
    curly (jingalak) ↔ straight (tekis)

18  'Hope to HEAR from you soon.'
    ⚠ 'hear FROM somebody' = kimdandir
    xabar olmoq (xat oxiridagi ibora).

20  'I LIKE playing computer games.'
    'like + V-ing' — yoqtirmoq.


⚠ 20-BANDDAGI VERGUL:
  Kitobda bo'sh joydan keyin VERGUL bosilgan:
     'I ........., playing computer games.'

  Vergul mantiqan ortiqcha — to'g'ri gap:
     'I LIKE playing computer games.'

  Bu bosma xato yoki skanerlash izi;
  javobga ta'sir qilmaydi.


DIQQAT — 'HAIR' SANALMAYDIGAN:
  'curly hair' / 'straight hair'
  'hairs' — XATO.


DIQQAT — 'WHAT SORT OF ...?':
  'What SORT OF hair has she got?'
  = qanday sochi bor?
  'sort of' = 'kind of' = 'type of'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an astronaut = kosmonavt
  a sort of    = turi, xili
  curly        = jingalak
  straight     = tekis (soch)
  indeed       = haqiqatan
  in need      = muhtojlikda
  quite well   = ancha yaxshi

tasks.whyUz:
'be FROM a place' = ... dan bo'lmoq.

'Where are you FROM?' — 19-band bilan
bir xil qoida.

'they' — KO'PLIK → ARE.

  I → am
  he/she/it → is
  you/we/they → are

⚠ 'astronaut' UNLI tovush bilan boshlanadi
→ 'AN'.

'a astronaut' — XATO.

A → undosh tovush oldidan;
AN → unli tovush oldidan.

tasks.prompt: 4  This is Steve Richway. ................. is a teacher.
tasks.whyUz:
Stiv — ERKAK ismi → HE.

Ikkinchi gapda ismni takrorlash o'rniga
OLMOSH ishlatiladi.
tasks.speak: 4  This is Steve Richway. ................. is a teacher.

tasks.whyUz:
'HOW old are you?' — turg'un savol.

Javobi: 'I am twelve years old.' (11-band)

'WHAT'S your name?' = What IS your name?

'How is your name?' — XATO.

QISQA JAVOB: savoldagi fe'l takrorlanadi.

'IS she ...?' → 'No, she ISN'T.'

'No, she isn't from Italy' — to'liq shakl,
lekin qisqa javob yetarli.

'she' → HAS got.

'have got' savol shakli:
  HAS he/she/it got ...?
  HAVE I/you/we/they got ...?

'what SORT OF' = qanday, qanaqa.

⚠ 'EYES' — KO'PLIK → ARE!

'What colour IS your hair?' (hair —
SANALMAYDIGAN, birlik)
'What colour ARE your eyes?' (eyes — ko'plik)

SAVOLDA 'be' EGADAN OLDIN keladi:
  'You ARE from Australia.' (tasdiq)
  'ARE you from Australia?' (savol)

'you' → ARE.

'I' bilan DOIM 'AM'.

⚠ Yoshni aytishda 'BE' ishlatiladi:
  'I AM twelve.'  ✓
  'I HAVE twelve years.' ✗

SHAHAR bilan 'IN':
  in London / in Tashkent / in Paris

Aniq manzil bilan 'AT':
  'at 4, Pine Street'

'Pierre' — bitta odam (3-shaxs birlik)
→ HAS got.

Savolda 'has' GAP BOSHIDA:
'HAS Pierre got green eyes?'

QOBILIYAT haqida → CAN.

Keyin ASOSIY shakl: 'Can you SING?'
('Can you to sing?' XATO)

'quite well' = ancha yaxshi.

⚠ Bu — INGLIZ MAQOLI!

'A FRIEND in need is a friend indeed.'
So'zma-so'z: 'Muhtojlikdagi do'st — haqiqiy
do'st.'

Qofiya: nEED — indEED.

QOBILIYAT → CAN.

⚠ 'can' 3-shaxsda O'ZGARMAYDI:
  'He CAN run.'   ✓
  'He CANS run.'  ✗
  'He can RUNS.'  ✗

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  B favourite
   2  A has got
   3  C yellow
   4  C Can
   5  B am
   6  B Where
   7  C at
   8  B middle-aged
   9  A playing
  10  B speak


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'What's your FAVOURITE sport?'
    = eng yoqtirgan sportingiz qaysi?
    'big sport' / 'small sport' — mantiqsiz.

 2  'She HAS GOT wavy hair.'
    'she' → HAS got ('have got' XATO).
    'She IS wavy hair' — mantiqsiz.

 3  'Lemons are YELLOW.'
    Limon SARIQ bo'ladi.

 4  'CAN you help me, please?'
    Iltimos → CAN.
    'Have you help me' / 'Are you help me' —
    grammatik jihatdan XATO.

 5  'Hi! I AM John Smith.'
    'I' bilan DOIM 'am'.

 6  'WHERE is Marco from?'
    Javob joy bo'lardi → WHERE.
    'How is Marco from?' — mantiqsiz.

 7  'I'm a student AT an English boarding
     school.'
    ⚠ Maktab/universitet bilan 'AT':
       'a student AT a school'
       'AT university'

 8  'He is forty-one. He is MIDDLE-AGED.'
    41 yosh — o'rta yosh.
       young = yosh (bola, o'smir)
       middle-aged = o'rta yoshli (40-60)
       old = keksa

 9  'I like PLAYING the guitar.'
    ⚠ 'PLAY the guitar' — cholg'u asbobi
    bilan 'play'.
    'sing the guitar' / 'cook the guitar' —
    mantiqsiz.

10  'I can SPEAK French. Can you?'
    ⚠ TIL bilan 'SPEAK':
       'speak French/English/Uzbek'
    'swim French' — mantiqsiz;
    'like French' — grammatik to'g'ri, lekin
    'Can you?' savoliga mos kelmaydi
    (qobiliyat haqida).


⚠ 7-BAND — ENG NOZIK:
  'a student AT a school'
     'at' — biror muassasada o'qish.
  'from' — kelib chiqish (Daniel is FROM
     Lisbon).
  'to' — yo'nalish.


⚠ 9-BAND — CHOLG'U ASBOBLARI:
  'PLAY THE guitar/piano/violin'
     — artikl 'the' bilan!

  Sport bilan artikl YO'Q:
     'PLAY football/tennis'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  favourite   = eng yoqtirgan
  wavy        = to'lqinsimon
  a lemon     = limon
  a boarding school = internat maktab
  middle-aged = o'rta yoshli
  a guitar    = gitara
  French      = fransuz tili

'How is Marco from?' — mantiqsiz.

exercises.explanationUz:
BEShTA DIALOG — SAVOLNI TOPISh KERAK.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  A: 'HOW ARE YOU?'
    B: 'Very well, thanks.'

 2  A: 'WHAT'S YOUR PHONE NUMBER?'
    B: 'It's 6684231.'

 3  A: 'WHAT'S YOUR ADDRESS?'
    B: '4, Pine Street.'

 4  A: 'IS HE TALL?'
    B: 'No, he isn't. He's short.'

 5  A: 'WHAT COLOUR ARE HIS EYES?'
    B: 'His eyes are blue.'


QANDAY TOPILADI — JAVOBGA QARANG:

 1  'Very well, thanks.' = juda yaxshi,
    rahmat.
    → AHVOL so'ralgan.
    'How are you?' / 'How are things?'

 2  'It's 6684231.' — RAQAM.
    → TELEFON RAQAMI so'ralgan.
    'What's your phone number?'

 3  '4, Pine Street.' — MANZIL.
    → MANZIL so'ralgan.
    'What's your address?'

 4  'No, he ISN'T. He's SHORT.'
    → Javob 'yes/no' — demak savol
      YORDAMCHI FE'L bilan boshlangan.
      'short' ning zidi — 'tall'.
    'Is he tall?'

 5  'His eyes are BLUE.' — RANG.
    → RANG so'ralgan.
    'What colour are his eyes?'


⚠ 4-BAND — ENG NOZIK:

  Javob 'No, he isn't' — bu QISQA JAVOB,
  demak savol 'IS ...?' bilan boshlanadi
  ('What ...?' emas).

  Va javobda 'He's SHORT' deyilgan, demak
  savolda ZID sifat bo'lgan → 'TALL'.

  ⚠ 'Is he short?' bo'lsa, javob 'YES, he
  is' bo'lardi!


⚠ 5-BAND — 'ARE' EMAS, 'IS' EMAS:
  'What colour ARE his EYES?'
  'eyes' — KO'PLIK → ARE

  (1-mashqning 9-bandi bilan bir xil.)


BOShQA MUMKIN VARIANTLAR:

 1  'How are things?' / 'How's it going?'
 2  'Can I have your phone number?'
 3  'Where do you live?'
    (lekin javob '4, Pine Street' —
     manzil, shuning uchun 'What's your
     address?' aniqroq)
 4  'Is your brother tall?'
 5  'What colour are his eyes?' — eng
    aniq


DIQQAT — TELEFON RAQAMI:
  Ingliz tilida raqamlar BITTALAB o'qiladi:
     6684231 →
     'six six eight four two three one'

  Ikkita bir xil raqam ketma-ket kelsa,
  'DOUBLE' deyish mumkin:
     '66' → 'double six'

  (Unit 2 word list'da 'double' bor!)


DIQQAT — MANZIL TARTIBI:
  '4, Pine Street'
  Avval UY RAQAMI, keyin KO'ChA nomi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Very well, thanks = juda yaxshi, rahmat
  a phone number = telefon raqami
  an address  = manzil
  a street    = ko'cha
  tall        = baland bo'yli
  short       = past bo'yli

tasks.uz: 1 A: Yaxshimisiz? B: Juda yaxshi, rahmat.

KALIT: 'Very well, thanks' — AHVOL haqida
javob.

Boshqa variantlar: 'How are things?',
'How's it going?'

tasks.en: 2  A: What's your phone number?   B: It's 6684231.
tasks.note:
KALIT: javob — RAQAM.

⚠ Raqamlar BITTALAB o'qiladi:
'six six eight four two three one'.
'66' ni 'DOUBLE six' deb ham aytish mumkin.

tasks.en: 3  A: What's your address?   B: 4, Pine Street.
tasks.uz: 3 A: Manzilingiz qayerda? B: Payn ko'chasi, 4-uy.
tasks.note:
KALIT: javob — MANZIL.

⚠ Ingliz manzilida avval UY RAQAMI, keyin
KO'CHA nomi: '4, Pine Street'.

tasks.en: 4  A: Is he tall?   B: No, he isn't. He's short.
tasks.uz: 4 A: U baland bo'ylimi? B: Yo'q. U past bo'yli.
tasks.note:
⚠ ENG NOZIK BAND!

IKKI KALIT:
a) javob 'No, he ISN'T' — QISQA JAVOB, demak
   savol 'IS ...?' bilan boshlanadi;
b) 'He's SHORT' — demak savolda ZID sifat
   bo'lgan → TALL.

'Is he short?' bo'lsa, javob 'YES' bo'lardi!

tasks.en: 5  A: What colour are his eyes?   B: His eyes are blue.
tasks.uz: 5 A: Uning ko'zlari qanday rangda? B: Ko'zlari ko'k.
tasks.note:
KALIT: javob — RANG.

⚠ 'EYES' — KO'PLIK → 'What colour ARE ...?'
('What colour IS your hair?' — hair
SANALMAYDIGAN).
